profile.name: Opentrons PCR热循环仪
profile.description: 用于PCR等热循环实验的台式热循环仪模块，配有可开合的加热盖和可精确控温的样品块，可按预设程序执行多步升降温循环。常用于DNA扩增、酶反应孵育和分子生物学样品热处理。
profile.description_en: A benchtop thermocycler module for PCR and other thermal cycling workflows, featuring an openable heated lid and a temperature-controlled sample block. It runs programmed multi-step temperature profiles for DNA amplification, enzymatic incubations, and molecular biology sample heating.
